supportedClaims: Persisted bounded Clifford+T optimization evidence with independent QASM parsing, resource recounting, dense unitary equivalence (<=6 qubits) and central Acceptance.
outOfScope: Hardware routing, noise/measurement semantics, guaranteed gate-count reduction or independent dense unitary proof beyond 6 qubits, 512 input gates or 2048 emitted gates.
Independent proof of upstream PyZX rewrite soundness across arbitrary circuits.

checks.criterion: Persisted optimization request satisfies its JSON Schema and bounded gate contract.
Persisted optimization result satisfies its JSON Schema.
Independently parse every emitted before/after OpenQASM 2 gate, angle, arity and wire.
Emitted input gate table exactly binds to the request, including the declared Y-to-X-then-Z expansion.
Before and after gate, T, two-qubit counts and dependency depth match independent recount.
Reported reference mode binds to the requested referenceMode.
When within <=6 qubits, <=512 input gates, <=2048 emitted gates and reference enabled, emitted input QASM reproduces the original unitary up to global phase.

When within <=6 qubits, <=512 input gates, <=2048 emitted gates and reference enabled, independent dense matrix multiplication confirms global-phase-aligned unitary equivalence and unit normalized trace overlap.
When the Tool reports a computed unitary reference, its equivalence flag and max error match independent recomputation.
Every performed independent check is non-failing; optional reference availability cannot hide a scientific contradiction.
Actual re-read canonical input and artifact bytes match their digests and actual Harness event range.
